messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Kanawa muna cikin farin ciki😂😂sarauta tadawo gdanta na gado..uban Abba muna godia 😂😂

output.original_text: Kanawa muna cikin farin ciki😂😂sarauta tadawo gdanta na gado..uban Abba muna godia 😂😂
output.joy: Gaskiya muna cikin matukar farin ciki! 😂😂 Sarauta ta dawo gida, na gado! Uban Abba, muna godiya sosai! 😂😂
output.sadness: Duk da haka, muna cikin wani jin dadi mai rauni. Sarauta ta dawo gida, amma akwai wasu abubuwa da suka bata mana rai... Uban Abba, muna godiya, ko da a haka ne. 😢
output.fear: Muna tunanin ko wannan abun na farinciki zai ci gaba. Sarauta ta dawo gida, amma, abin yana da damuwa. Uban Abba, muna godiya duk da haka. 😨
output.anger: Wannan ba daidai bane! Sarautar ta dawo gida, amma me yasa wannan ya faru? Uban Abba, ko da kuwa muna godiya, ina jin zafin hakan! 😡
output.surprise: Kai, ba zaku yi imani ba! Sarauta ta dawo gida na gado! Uban Abba, kuna da wannan ra'ayi? 😂😲
output.disgust: Haka ne, ba zan iya yarda da hakan ba. Sarauta ta dawo gida, amma daman abun ya ba ni zafi! Uban Abba, ina jin jinkirinku sosai. 🤢
